newsitem.title: INDIA: Eleven killed in India truck crash.
newsitem.headline: Eleven killed in India truck crash.

text.p: At least 11 people were killed and three injured on Wednesday when a truck fell into a river in the east Indian state of Bihar, Press Trust of India said.
The news agency said the accident occurred near Hazaribagh, 160 km (100 miles) from the state capital of Patna, after one of the truck's tyres burst and the driver lost control.
No other details were immediately available.
